scripts.copy: cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp -r src/assets/images dist/assets/images
scripts.build: npm run copy && tailwindcss -i src/assets/css/input.css -o dist/assets/css/style.css --minify
scripts.dev: npm run copy && concurrently "tailwindcss -i src/assets/css/input.css -o dist/assets/css/style.css --watch" "npm run watch:html" "browser-sync start --server dist --files 'dist/**/*' --no-open" --kill-others
